findings.title: Route path is a pattern that its match type compares as text
findings.cause: rule 1 of HTTPRoute shop matches path /api/* with type PathPrefix, which compares it as text, not as a pattern: only a request for exactly /api/* matches, so the requests meant for the rule get a 404 or go to another rule
findings.fix: Use path /api with type PathPrefix, which matches it and everything under it, or type RegularExpression if the Gateway's implementation supports it.
